messages:
auditor_mark: Hi team — we need SOC2/ISO evidence for the enclave (VPC + KMS keys) covering RBAC changes, KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls, key rotations, and any incident linkages for the past 12 months. ETA?

nina(sec): We can produce: RBAC change list (k8s + IAM), KMS CloudTrail extracts, key rotation manifest, and incident correlation CSV. Need to confirm redaction rules.

marta(devops): Quick Q: full raw 12 months or sampled windows + full around incidents? Sampling ok if documented.

auditor_mark: Prefer full 12 months; sampling acceptable with precise method and incident windows fully included.

li(dev): For k8s RBAC I will run: 
```
index=cluster-logs source=k8s_audit ("RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding") | table @timestamp, user, verb, objectRef.name
```
Will output CSV with before/after where available.

ops_sam: KMS pipeline: CloudTrail -> S3. Athena query for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey and STS joins. Example: 
```sql
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters.keyId FROM cloudtrail WHERE eventName IN ('Decrypt','GenerateDataKey')
```
We can export gzipped CSVs.

nina(sec): Include STS AssumeRole linkage (temp creds) and attestations: who exported, checksums, manifest.

marta(devops): I'll own exports. Li owns incident mapping. Nina will draft control mapping to SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9. Sam please provision secure share.

ops_sam: Will create pre-signed S3 share (14d expiry) and provide signed manifest with SHA256s. ETA for full bundle ~5 business days.

auditor_mark: 5 days works. Please include redaction log (what was masked) and chain-of-custody attestation.

li(dev): Incident example to include: IR-2026-007 — role change + anomalous Decrypt 3h later. I'll add timeline + sanitized logs.

marta(devops): Noted. Starting exports tomorrow, will post progress here.

auditbot: export queued: id=exp-3612 owner=marta ETA=24h (automated).

auditor_mark: Thanks — @nina please ping when share is ready.
